title: A Critical Look at Power Sampling when Test Time Sharpening LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.13653v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved LLM reasoning, yet growing evidence suggests it mainly performs distribution sharpening: concentrating probability mass on reasoning paths the base model already produces. Recent work therefore seeks RLVR's gains without needing reward signals, by sampling from the power distribution $\pi_\alpha \propto \pi_{\text{base}}^\alpha$ via Markov chain Monte Carlo or sequential Monte Carlo. translated_title: 对测试时锐化大语言模型中幂采样的批判性审视
translated_abstract: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已显著提升了大语言模型的推理能力，然而越来越多的证据表明，它主要进行的是分布锐化：将概率质量集中在基础模型本身已经能够产生的推理路径上。因此，近期研究试图在不需要奖励信号的情况下获得RLVR的收益，其方法是通过马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）或序列蒙特卡洛（SMC）从幂分布 $\pi_\alpha \propto \pi_{\text{base}}^\alpha$ 中进行采样。我们证明，在现实的计算预算下，这些采样器无法收敛到 $\pi_\alpha$，并且它们的收益可以通过简单的 Best-of-$N$ 采样（配合适当的评分）大体复现。这表明它们成功的原因在于选择了高概率序列，而非近似 $\pi_\alpha$，由此引出一个自然的问题：幂分布本身是否是一个值得追求的目标？我们通过微调基础模型使其匹配 $\pi_\alpha$ 来直接检验这一假设，从而绕开了采样器带来的复杂性。
tldr: 该论文证明基于MCMC/SMC的幂采样方法在现实计算预算下无法收敛到目标幂分布，其收益可由简单的Best-of-N采样复现，表明其成功源于筛选高概率序列而非真正近似幂分布。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that power sampling via MCMC/SMC fails to converge to the target power distribution under realistic compute budgets, and its gains can be largely replicated by simple Best-of-N sampling, suggesting its success stems from selecting high-probability sequences rather than approximating the power distribution itself.
